DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 少しお口を開けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Could you open your mouth a little?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: すみません。長く開けているとあごが疲れます。途中で休みたい時の伝え方を先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 長時間開口で顎が疲れ休止合図を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Sorry, my jaw gets tired if I keep it open for a long time. Before we start, please tell me how to signal if I need a break partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that keeping your mouth open tires your jaw, and ask in advance for a signal to request a pause. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 休みたい時は手を上げてください。器具を止めてから声をおかけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Raise your hand if you need a break. We will stop the instruments and then speak to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 手を上げるのですね。口の中に器具がある時、急に顔を背けず、まず合図します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 顔を急に背けず挙手すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: So I should raise my hand. If there are instruments in my mouth, I will signal first rather than suddenly turn my face away.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will raise your hand rather than suddenly turn your face away. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: つらさが出たら我慢し続けずに知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: If you start feeling uncomfortable, let us know rather than continuing to put up with it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 今の時点では痛みより疲れです。以前も長く開けた後に疲れたので、始める前に話しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 痛みより疲れと過去の状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: At the moment it is more tiredness than pain. My jaw also got tired after I kept my mouth open for a long time before, so I want to mention it before we start.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Explain that it is tiredness rather than pain, and describe what happened before. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 状況を伺いました。必要に応じて休みながら進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you for explaining. We will take breaks as needed as we proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一度、手を上げる動きを見てもらってから始めたいです。この高さで分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 挙手位置が見えるか実演確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. Before we start, I would like you to watch me raise my hand once. Can you see it at this height?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Demonstrate raising your hand and check whether its position is visible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい、見えます。合図があれば安全を確認して中断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, I can see it. If you signal, we will check that it is safe and pause.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 分かりました。疲れた時はこの合図を使い、声をかけられてから口を閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 合図後声掛けを待ち口を閉じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: I understand. When I get tired, I will use this signal and close my mouth after you speak to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say that you will signal, wait to be spoken to, and then close your mouth. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 合図を確認できました。器具の準備をしてきますので、少しお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-04-001-SHARED-.translation: We have checked the signal. I will go and prepare the instruments, so please wait a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: まだご乗車の予定がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Are you still planning to take a train?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 最終列車に間に合いませんでした。家へ帰るには、ほかにどんな方法がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 終電を逃し代わりの帰宅手段を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I missed the last train. What other ways are there to get home?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you missed the last train and ask about alternative ways home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 本日の列車の案内を確認します。お帰りの方面を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I will check today's train information. Please tell me which direction you are going home in.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: この地図の辺りです。友人が近くに住んでいるので、迎えを頼めるか聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 帰宅先を地図で示し友人へ迎えを頼めるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Around this area on the map. A friend lives nearby, so I will ask whether they can pick me up.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Point out your destination on the map and ask your friend whether they can pick you up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 駅の外の交通案内をご覧いただけます。お迎えが難しい場合もご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: You can look at the transport information outside the station. Please also ask us if getting picked up is difficult.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: まず友人へ電話します。迎えが難しければ、タクシー乗り場の場所を教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 友人不能ならタクシー乗場案内を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I will call my friend first. If they cannot pick me up, I would like you to tell me where the taxi rank is.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask for directions to the taxi rank if your friend cannot pick you up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: タクシーの案内は、こちらの出口で確認できます。車の待ち時間や料金は、利用先へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: You can check the taxi information at this exit. Please ask the operator about the waiting time and fare.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 友人は来られないと分かりました。その出口へ行き、料金を聞いてから利用を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 友人不能確認し出口で料金確認後利用判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: My friend has confirmed they cannot come. I will go to that exit and ask the fare before deciding whether to take a taxi.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend cannot come, and decide whether to take a taxi after checking the fare at the exit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 駅の外へ出る際も、お荷物を忘れずお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Please remember to take your belongings when you go outside the station too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 荷物はそろいました。家族へ遅くなると伝え、帰り方が決まったら改めて連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 荷物確認し家族へ遅延と帰宅方法決定後連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: I have all my belongings. I will tell my family I will be late and contact them again once I have decided how to get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check your belongings, tell your family you will be late, and contact them again after choosing how to get home. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: どうぞ無理のない移動方法をご確認ください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-05-001-SHARED-.translation: Please find a way to travel that is manageable for you. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 洗い場で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Are you having trouble with something in the washing area?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 低い物が二つあります。この丸い容器に座ろうとしていましたが、洗面器なのですね。椅子は別ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 丸容器が椅子か洗面器か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: There are two low objects. I was about to sit on this round container, but it is a washbasin, right? Is the stool separate?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether the round container is a stool or a washbasin. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。穴のあるこちらが椅子で、丸い容器は湯をくむ洗面器です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. This one with a hole is the stool, and the round container is a basin for scooping bathwater.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。椅子を使いたいのですが、空いている物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 道具の違いを理解し空いている椅子を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. I would like to use a stool; is there one available?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Show you understand the difference between the items and ask for an available stool. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 椅子は空いているこちらをお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Please use this available stool here.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらの椅子を使います。洗面器は床の通路ではなく、自分の洗う場所に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 指定椅子と自己洗場に容器を置くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: I will use this stool. I will put the basin in my own washing space rather than in the walkway on the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you will use the indicated stool and put the container in your own washing space. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 立ち上がる時も、周りの人や足元にご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: When you stand up, please also watch the people around you and your footing.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。持ち上げた洗面器で、隣の方へ湯をかけないよう、自分の前でゆっくり使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 隣へ湯をかけず前でゆっくり使うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. I will use the basin slowly in front of me so I do not splash the person next to me with hot water when I lift it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Say you will use it slowly in front of you without splashing the person beside you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 使い終わったら、軽く流して元の場所へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: When you are done, give them a quick rinse and return them to their original place.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 使い終わったら両方を流して戻します。戻す場所もここで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 使用後の洗浄と返却場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: When I finish, I will rinse both and put them back. Is this also the correct place to return them?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Confirm rinsing after use and the return location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい、こちらへお戻しください。それでは、ごゆっくりお入りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-06-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, please return them here. Enjoy your bath.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 店内の機器について、お問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Is your question about the equipment in the store?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい。朝の仕事で使う紙を一枚コピーしたいです。深夜ですが、今コピー機を使えるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 深夜に紙一枚コピー機使用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes. I want to copy one sheet for work in the morning. It is late at night, but could you tell me whether I can use the copier now?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can use the copier late at night to copy one sheet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらの機器は今お使いいただけます。白黒のコピーでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: You can use this machine now. Is a black-and-white copy all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 白黒で一枚お願いします。この紙を原稿に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 原紙を示し白黒一枚と指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: One black-and-white copy, please. I will use this sheet as the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Show the original sheet and specify one black-and-white copy. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 操作の案内をこちらでご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: You can read the operating instructions here.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 案内を見ます。まず料金を確かめてからお金を入れたいです。紙はどの向きに置くかも確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 支払前料金と原稿向き確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I will read them. I would like to check the price before inserting money. Please also let me check which way to place the sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask to check the price and original sheet orientation before paying. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 一枚十円です。紙を置く向きはこちらの図をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: It is ten yen per sheet. Please look at this diagram for the direction to place the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 向きを合わせました。一枚だけの設定になっているか見てから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 方向合わせ一枚設定を確認して始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: I have placed it the right way. I will check that it is set to just one copy before starting.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Align the sheet, check the one-copy setting, and start. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 終わりましたら、原稿も忘れずお取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: When you are finished, remember to take the original too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: コピーができました。原稿も取りました。十円で合っていましたね。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintJa: コピーと原稿を回収し料金を確認して礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: The copy is done. I have taken the original too. It was ten yen, as you said. Thank you.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Collect the copy and original, confirm the price, and say thank you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ご利用ありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-07-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you for using our service. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お皿について、何かございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Is there something about the plate?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 縁に黒い線が見えます。模様なのか、ひびなのか分からないので、見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 皿の黒い線が模様かひびか確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I can see a black line on the rim. I cannot tell whether it is a pattern or a crack; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to check whether the plate's black line is a pattern or a crack. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 確認しますので、いったんお皿をお預かりしてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: May I take the plate for a moment to check it?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お願いします。まだ料理が残っています。汁もあるので、私が持ち上げるより、このまま取っていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 料理と汁が残る皿をそのまま店員に取ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Please do. There is still food on it, including some liquid, so it would help if you could take it as it is rather than have me lift it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to take the plate as it is, with food and liquid remaining. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: こちらで拝見しました。この線は表面の仕上げの下にある模様です。気になるようでしたら、別のお皿をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I have checked it. This line is a pattern beneath the surface finish. If it bothers you, I can bring a different plate.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 模様なのですね。教えていただいて安心しました。ただ、食べながらまた気になりそうなので、無地の皿に変えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 模様と理解して無地の皿への交換を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: So it is a pattern. I am relieved to know that. Still, I think I may worry about it again while eating; could you change it to a plain plate?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Show you understand it is a pattern and request a plain plate instead. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: 無地のお皿をご用意できます。お料理もこちらで移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: We can provide a plain plate. We will transfer the food too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。汁をこぼしそうなので、移すところもお願いしたいです。料理は捨てずに、そのまま食べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 汁のある料理の移し替えを店員へ頼み料理は食べ続けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Thank you. I might spill the liquid, so I would like you to transfer it as well. Please do not throw the food away; I would like to keep eating it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to transfer the food with liquid and explain you want to continue eating it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: お料理を移しました。こちらの無地のお皿でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: I have transferred the food. Is this plain plate all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: はい、これなら分かりやすいです。料理も残っているので、続きをいただきます。確認してくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintJa: 交換皿と残った料理を確認し礼を言って食事を続ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: Yes, this makes it easier to tell. The food is still here too, so I will continue eating. Thank you for checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.hintTranslation: Check the replacement plate and remaining food, say thank you, and continue eating. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.sourceJa: どういたしまして。気になることがあれば、またお声がけください。それでは、ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-ICHINOMIYA-08-001-SHARED-.translation: You are welcome. If anything else concerns you, please let us know. Enjoy the rest of your meal.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 石垣の説明で、分からない言葉はありましたか。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were there any words in the explanation of the stone wall that you did not understand?

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「いしがき」と聞こえました。人の名前かと思いましたが、この壁のことですか。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 石垣の言葉が目の前の石壁を指すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard “ishigaki.” I thought it was someone's name; does it mean this wall?
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether “ishigaki” refers to the stone wall in front of you. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。石を積んで作った、この壁のことです。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. It means this wall made of stones stacked together.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: なるほど。下の石と上の石で、大きさが違って見えますね。説明の絵でも同じ所を見られますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 石の大きさの違いを述べ対応する説明図を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. The stones at the bottom and the top look different in size. Can I see the same part in the explanatory illustration?
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Mention the different stone sizes and ask about the matching explanatory illustration. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: このページに、石を積んだ様子を描いた絵があります。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this page, there is an illustration showing how the stones are stacked.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。家族にも見せたいので、説明のページ番号を控えておきます。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族に説明できるよう案内のページ番号を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I want to show my family too, so I will note the page number of the explanation.
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Note the guide's page number so you can explain it to your family. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実物をご覧になる時は、こちらの柵の内側でお願いします。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: When viewing the actual wall, please stay inside this fence.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここから見ます。石の間に線が見えるのですが、全部ひび割れなのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 柵内から観察し石の間の線の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look from here. I can see lines between the stones; are they all cracks?
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Observe from inside the fence and ask what the lines between the stones mean. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 石と石の境目もあります。傷みかどうかは、見た線だけでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Some are the boundaries between stones. We cannot judge whether there is damage just from the lines you see.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうなのですね。家族には石を積んだ壁だと説明して、線についてはこの説明を一緒に読みます。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 石壁の意味を家族へ伝え線の説明も一緒に読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see. I will explain to my family that it is a wall made of stacked stones, and we will read this explanation about the lines together.
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your family what the stone wall means and read the explanation of the lines together too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ごゆっくりご見学ください。ご質問ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-AIC-INUYAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy your visit. Thank you for your questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお部屋もご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to see this room too?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。キャスター付きのかばんを持っていますが、畳の上を転がしてもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: キャスターかばんを畳で転がせるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have a wheeled bag; may I roll it over the tatami?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can roll your wheeled bag on the tatami. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 畳の上では転がさず、入口の荷物置き場をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not roll it over the tatami; use the luggage area at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中には財布が入っています。全部置いたままにせず、財布だけ取り出して持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 財布だけ取り出して荷物置き場利用を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My wallet is inside. Rather than leave everything there, I will take just my wallet out and bring it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to use the luggage area after taking out just your wallet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物置き場はこの板の上です。ほかのお客様の靴とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The luggage area is on this board. Please keep your bag separate from other visitors' shoes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 板の上へ置きました。かばんの持ち手を伸ばしたままだと通る人に当たりそうなので、縮めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 板上配置と持ち手収納を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put it on the board. If I leave the handle extended, it might hit people passing by, so I will retract it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have placed it on the board and will retract the handle. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お部屋では、展示している座布団にはお座りにならないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Inside the room, please do not sit on the cushions on display.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示の座布団ですね。疲れた時に座れる物だと思っていました。休憩の椅子は別にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 展示座布団と休憩椅子を区別して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Those cushions are exhibits, then. I thought they were for sitting on when tired. Are there separate chairs for resting?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the display cushions from chairs for resting and ask about them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 廊下の端に、来館者用の椅子があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are chairs for visitors at the end of the corridor.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこを使います。見学の後でかばんを取りに戻り、畳へ上げずに持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 来館者椅子で休み後で荷物回収すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use those. After the visit I will come back for my bag and take it home without putting it on the tatami.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rest on the visitor chairs and collect your luggage afterward. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お部屋をお楽しみください。お戻りの際もお荷物をお忘れなく。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy the room. Please remember your belongings when you return. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おまんじゅうをお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for manju buns?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。店先から蒸気が出ていますが、今見えている物をすぐ買えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 蒸している分をすぐ購入可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is steam coming from the storefront; can I buy the ones I can see right now straight away?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the buns currently being steamed can be bought immediately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今蒸している分は、まだお渡しできません。出来上がった分はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot hand over the batch still steaming yet. These here are the finished ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出来上がっている方を二つお願いします。どこで受け取ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 出来上がった菓子二つを注文し受取場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two of the finished ones, please. Where should I collect them?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Order two finished sweets and ask where to collect them. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらからお渡しします。すぐお召し上がりになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will hand them to you here. Will you eat them right away?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つは今食べて、もう一つは友人へ持って行きます。持ち帰る方だけ包んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 即食用と友人への持帰り用を分け持帰り一つの包装を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will eat one now and take the other to a friend. Could you wrap just the one to take away?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the one to eat now from the one for your friend and ask for only the takeaway one to be wrapped. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しする時に、一つだけ取り出せるようにします。熱いのでお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will hand them over so you can take out just one. Please be careful, as they are hot.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今食べる一つは、こちらで受け取ればよいのですね。手で持ちやすい紙も付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 即食用の受取場所を確認し手で持つための紙を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I collect the one to eat now here, right? Could you also include some paper to make it easier to hold?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the collection point for the one to eat now and request paper for holding it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紙を付けてお渡しします。友人の分は、この包みのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will give you some paper with it. Please carry your friend's one in this wrapping.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つ受け取りました。友人の分は包みを開けずに持ちます。どちらが持ち帰りか分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封の友人用と即食用を分けたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received one. I will carry my friend's without opening the wrapping. I know which one is for taking away now.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have separated the one to eat now from your friend's unopened takeaway one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お召し上がりください。お買い上げありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy it. Thank you for your purchase. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今は乗りません。明日の朝、荷物を運ぶための車を予約したいのですが、ここで相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今の乗車でなく翌朝の予約相談と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not now. I would like to book a car for moving my belongings tomorrow morning. Can I ask about that here?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you want to discuss a booking for tomorrow morning, rather than a ride now. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配車の窓口へご相談いただきます。お迎えの場所は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please contact the dispatch desk. Have you decided the pickup location?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引っ越し先ではなく、今住んでいる家の入口です。こちらに住所を書いたので、予約窓口へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧居の入口を迎車場所として住所で示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The entrance to my current home, not the place I am moving to. I have written the address here and would like to give it to the booking desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the written address to identify the entrance to your old home as the pickup location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車に載せる荷物の大きさもお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell them the size of the belongings to go in the car.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 段ボール三箱です。一番大きい箱の寸法も測ってあるので、予約の時に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 段ボール三箱と大きい箱の寸法を予約窓口へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Three cardboard boxes. I have measured the largest box too, so I will give those dimensions when booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell the booking desk about the three boxes and the largest box's dimensions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが予約窓口の連絡先です。空車があるかは、窓口で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here are the booking desk's contact details. Please check availability with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡して、明日の八時にお願いできるか聞いてみます。返事が来たら、場所と荷物も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌朝八時の配車可否を窓口へ連絡して確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will contact them and ask whether they can arrange it for eight tomorrow morning. When they reply, I will also confirm the location and luggage.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will contact the desk to check whether a car can be arranged for eight tomorrow morning. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日時、場所、荷物を一緒にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give them the date and time, location, and luggage details together.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日の朝八時、今の家の入口、段ボール三箱と伝えます。予約できた場合は、迎えに来る場所も読み返して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時住所箱数をまとめ窓口へ連絡し場所を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them tomorrow at eight in the morning, the entrance to my current home, and three cardboard boxes. If I can book, I will also read back the pickup location to check it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize the date, time, address, and box count for the desk and repeat the location for confirmation. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、窓口へご相談ください。お引っ越しのご準備もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss it with the booking desk. Take care with your moving preparations too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 前のご相談について、追加のご連絡ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us with additional information about your previous consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。来週引っ越すので、この相談の連絡先を変えたいです。控えを持って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転居前に既存相談の連絡先変更を控え持参で申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am moving next week, so I would like to change the contact details for this consultation. I have brought my copy of the record.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before moving, request a contact detail change for an existing consultation and say you brought the record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の相談の控えをお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the record of your current consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。相談した出来事は今の家で起きた物です。来週の住所は、今後連絡を受けるための住所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相談控えを示し旧居の出来事と新連絡住所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. The incident I consulted you about happened at my current home. Next week's address is for receiving future communications.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the consultation record and distinguish the incident at the old home from the new contact address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい住所で連絡を受けられる日は、いつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: From what date can you receive communications at the new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週の月曜からです。それまでは、今の住所で連絡を受けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来週月曜から新住所で連絡可で今日は未居住と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: From next Monday. Until then, you can reach me at my current address.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the new address is for contact from next Monday and you are not living there yet today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話の番号も変更のご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you also planning to change your phone number?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯番号は同じです。家の電話だけ使えなくなるので、急ぎの連絡方法も担当へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯維持だが固定電話停止で急連絡方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My mobile number will stay the same. Only the home phone will stop working, so I would also like to check with the person in charge how to reach me urgently.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your mobile number stays the same but the landline will stop, and check urgent contact arrangements. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更の内容を担当にお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge about the changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。出来事の場所は元の住所のまま、月曜以降の連絡住所だけが新しくなり、携帯は同じと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出来事住所維持と月曜以降新連絡住所携帯同じをまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will explain that the incident location remains the old address, only the contact address changes from Monday, and my mobile number stays the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize that the incident address is unchanged, the contact address changes from Monday, and the mobile number is the same. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、この控えで担当へ引き継ぎます。ご連絡ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-INUYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will use this record to hand the matter over to the person in charge. Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye.
